graphIssue: There are troubles with offer loadings with TheGraph. We are actively working on it, thanks for your understanding.
graphSyncing: The graph is syncing, data could not load properly. Please wait the synchronization completetion.

degradedMode.title: Degraded mode activated
degradedMode.message: TheGraph is inaccessible or offers cannot be loaded. Use the ID search below to access a specific offer via direct RPC.
degradedMode.tip: 💡 Tip: You can always view a specific offer by entering its ID below. This feature works even in degraded mode thanks to direct RPC calls (Multicall3).

userCopied.title: Copied 🎉
userCopied.message: Your address have been copied to clipboard.

usersNotFound.title: Error
usersNotFound.message: {{ usersNotFound }} users couldn't be retrieved. Check your RPC or refresh the table.

createOfferInvalid.title: Error
createOfferInvalid.message: You can not create this offer. Please make sure: You are whitelisted for the offer token, the offer token is whitelisted and not in locking periode.

buyOfferInvalid.title: Error
buyOfferInvalid.message: You can not buy this offer. Please make sure: You are whitelisted for the offer token, the offer token is not in locking periode, you have enough buyer token balance in your wallet to pay the offer.

indexingError.title: TheGraph Indexing Issue
indexingError.message: The TheGraph subgraph is experiencing indexing problems. Some data may be unavailable or outdated.
indexingError.tip: 💡 You can still use the offer ID search to access specific offers via direct RPC.

networkError.title: TheGraph Network Error
networkError.message: Unable to connect to TheGraph. Please check your internet connection.
networkError.tip: 💡 You can still use the offer ID search to access specific offers via direct RPC.

unknownError.title: TheGraph Error
unknownError.message: An error occurred while fetching data from TheGraph.
